SSH — devbox.example.com

  Route        routed to the gateway
  Host key     SHA256:FAKEGATEWAYHOSTKEY
  VM           lets the gateway's key in
               its host key is recorded for the gateway
  Paired       1 computer(s) (`devbox ssh keys`)

To set up a computer (macOS or Linux):

  curl -fsSL https://devbox.example.com/setup | sh
